programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 4. série, Badly Sprained Bear | While bickering with the Lemmings over control of the TV, Grizzy sees an illustration that gives him an idea. In a medical book, a person whose leg is in a cast is being served dinner in front of a TV. Grizzy pretends to have a twisted ankle and shows the Lemmings the patient care illustrations. The imaginary invalid Grizzy is so convincing that the Lemmings fall for the trick. They think that the sooner Grizzy is healed, the sooner they will be able to throw him out of the cabin as planned.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 4. série, Winning Tokens | On the beach, the Lemmings have set up a mini funfair for tourists. Each attraction lets you to win tickets, which are then used to collect prizes from a vending machine. Grizzy, who is not very good at games of skill, steals the tickets collected by the Lemmings in order to obtain the jackpot. The Lemmings decide to create an attraction just for him.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 4. série, Game of Marbles | The Lemmings discover that oysters can make pearls almost instantaneously: just put an object inside their shell and it’s automatically coated with mother-of-pearl The game of marbles that the Lemmings have invented with pearls is driving Grizzy crazy. He manages to catapult the Lemmings far away. But at the ocean bottom, they discover a giant oyster. All they need to create a giant-scale marble game!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 4. série, Five-Star Bowl | The Lemmings have adopted a small exotic fish that’s lively and affectionate and have fun decorating its aquarium. Jealous, Grizzy finds a fish too, but his is expressionless and indifferent to the bear’s efforts to communicate. Grizzy plots to exchange the two fish behind the Lemmings' backs. He puts the affectionate fish in an even bigger aquarium with a pharaonic decor and locks the lid. But the Lemmings have no intention of leaving their friend to Grizzy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 4. série, Lost Object | The Lemmings use all the cans and tins they can get their hands on to build a beach slide. Grizzy, annoyed at not finding his tinned fish to prepare his meal tray, recovers them from the Lemmings. In their struggle, Grizzy loses his badge! Grizzy and the Lemmings now fight over a valuable metal detector that each party needs to accomplish their goal: build a slide or find the beloved badge.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 4. série, Crab Crush | The Lemmings take a liking to an endangered crab on the beach and decide to shelter it from a seagull who is using its shell to open coconuts. They bring it home to a disgruntled Grizzy, who wants to watch TV in peace while snacking on Cheetos. When the Lemmings turn into full-fledged crab rescuers, the house is soon overrun with crustaceans. Grizzy decides to use the seagull to get rid of the crabs. But the Lemmings - ready to do anything to protect their new friends - embark the entire house, like a raft on water.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 4. série, Tale Of Two Teddies | When Scrapper claws a rip in Teddy, Mr Bean rushes him to the Teddy hospital. As Teddy is being fixed, Mr Bean is rather taken with another Ted on sale in the shop. He decided to take Big Ted home with him once Teddy is fixed. But at home it seems as though Big Ted is freezing Teddy out, and after a particularly terrifying nightmare, Mr Bean realises he has to get rid of his new guest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 4. série, Climbing Bean | Mr Bean takes Billy to a climbing centre but gets annoyed by a competitive dad who accuses him of being a beginner. Mr Bean insists he’s an expert but is made to prove it when they both compete for a trophy – the winner being the first to climb “The Big One”, a huge, scary wall for adults only! Mr Bean is determined to win but hadn’t counted on the competitive dad’s dirty tricks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 1. série, The Fly | RoadworksMr. Bean by si ráno rád trochu přispal, ovšem v tom mu brání oprava silnice přímo před domem, ve kterém bydlí. Nejen, že se musí vypořádat s neuvěřitelným hlukem, ale navíc mu otřesy ničí veškeré vybavení bytu. Rozhodne se tedy zabránit v pokračování opravy silnice.The SofaMr. Bean si uvědomuje, že potřebuje novou pohovku a tak vyrazí do obchodu pro novou. Cena nové pohovky ho však šokuje, protože Mr. Bean tolik peněz nemá. Nezbývá mu tedy nic jiného než si na novou pohovku vydělat.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 1. série, Mime Games | CampingMr. Bean si večer prohlíží své fotografie z dětství, na kterých stanoval. Je natolik unešen vzpomínkami, že se rozhodne následující den stanovat. Jeho starý stan však dosloužil a tak se musí vydat do obchodu.Chocks AwayMr. Bean tráví se svým medvídkem odpoledne v parku. Opodál však stojí chlapec, který si hraje s letadlem na dálkové ovládání, které ke vší smůle rozpárá medvídka Mr. Beana. Ten si to nenechá líbit a chystá tvrdou odplatu.

programme.title: Moley
programme.desc: Mr. Know It All | Moley is frustrated with his inability to do a crossword puzzle so he casts a spell with the aim of “knowing all the answers.” The spell works, but the more knowledge he gains, the bigger and brighter his head gets (figuratively and literally).

programme.title: Moley
programme.desc: Science Fair | Moley and his mom enter Mishmosh’s yearly science fair while the Gardener and Squirm plot to snag Manny.

programme.title: Moley
programme.desc: Lockdown | Moley and Dotty find themselves trapped inside Mishmosh’s lab when his state of the art security system is activated.

programme.title: Moley
programme.desc: Hurley Burley | Hurley, a giant boisterous adventuring mole who boasts of dangerous stories, comes to town looking to drag Moley on one of his adventures! Frightened of being thought a coward, Moley tries to avoid him.

programme.title: Moley
programme.desc: Old Coots Secret | When Moley and Dotty spot Old Coot sneaking around MoleTown, Dotty can’t resist following. Soon they discover his secret tunnel, but all is not what it seems.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Tom's Bakery | Tom is making pastries at the bakery. He takes Jerry and Tuffy and puts them in the pastries. Tuffy and Jerry both escape and make a pastry of their own, scaring Tom away.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: 1. série, Bouncing Back | Mush-Mush is very proud he invented a new game called Fruity Bounce, where he and his friends bounce as high as possible on the bouncier fruits they can find. Little did he know, the Mushups were fruit-bouncing way before he, Chep and Lilit did. So, Mush-Mush decides that if he can’t be the inventor of the game, he’ll at least be the best at it. Mushlers vs Mushups, game on !

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: 1. série, Morel in the Dark | When Mush-Mush discovers that Morel is afraid of the dark, he suggests that Chep, Lilit and he take the Mushlets to their first overnight forest camp. Morel is relieved. But when Mush-Mush and his friends later come back, panicked, and reveal that the Mushlets have disappeared, Morel has no choice but to face his fear and join our friends on their rescue mission in the dark!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: 1. série, The Adventurers | Because Mush-Mush, Chep and Lilit are always up to new adventures, Bolly has dubbed them The Adventurers. Flattered, our friends invite Bolly to choose his challenge to become an Adventurer too. Bolly will have to be the first Mushable to set foot somewhere. Mushton being crowded, Mush-Mush suggests they find an island, somewhere on the giant lake…

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: 1. série, Getting Truffy With It | Truff is happy. He has found a necklace that makes him even Truffier! Except he had no idea the necklace belongs to Starmush. And the Mushelder promised there will be consequences for whoever took it. Mush-Mush, Chep and Lilit now have to save Truff from being consequenced…

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: 1. série, Good Vibrations | Lilit is under pressure. Truff, the most talented musician in Mushton, has invited her, Mush-Mush and Chep to form a band with him. Only problem is they can hardly play music! Truff insists: they just need to relax and feel the groove. But when Truff tells his new band they will perform at the Food Snail, Lilit isn’t relaxed at all!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power
programme.desc: Raging Volcano | Kid Kazoom and Multy have to enter an active volcano to retrieve a new Kazoom fragment, again...

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show
programme.desc: 3. série, When You Leash Expect It | Ginger decides she wants to teach Tom to walk on a leash to ensure he gets much-needed exercise. Tom hates the leash and does not want to go for a walk. Finally, they're on their way, much to Tom's chagrin. Back home, Jerry and Tuffy proceed to raid the fridge.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show
programme.desc: 3. série, Calamari Jerry | Ginger leaves some frozen fish on the kitchen counter to thaw. Ginger and Rick warn Tom to keep his paws away, or he will not get anything to eat. Soon, a live baby octopus crawls out of the mouth of one of the thawing fish and jumps off the counter, looking for a place to hide. Jerry befriends him and does his best to protect him from Tom.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show
programme.desc: 3. série, Drone Sweet Drone | Up to their usual antics, Tom, Jerry and Spike get into monkey business with a drone at Rick and Ginger's house.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show
programme.desc: 3. série, Cattyshack | It's time for the annual croquet tournament at the Manor. The butler tells Tom how important it is to the Lady of the Manor to always win…no matter what! The last thing they need is any pesky rodents interfering with the game. Knowing any sighting of Jerry or Tuffy would cast Tom in a bad light, he's determined to keep them off the lawn.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: 1. série, 7. díl - Bibijin druhý pokus | Everyone is ecstatic when Bibi, Batgirl, and Robin capture Toyman and his Do-Over remote – except for Bibi, who failed to stick the landing on a big jump. Unwilling to accept her failure, Bibi uses Toyman’s Do-Over remote until she perfects her jump!

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: 1. série, 8. díl - Na druhé koleji | When Bam is sent to take on Prank, Redbird is forced to hang back because The Joker’s van is too dangerous! When Bam discovers that Redbird secretly tagged along, he’s upset… until Redbird bails him out of a tight spot.

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: 3. série, Which Watch | After a battle with Kevin gets cut short, Ben turns his attention to one upping Gwen at Space Camp. But, when Kevin returns with his sights strangely set on his cousin, our hero must uncover who is really behind it all, Charmcaster!

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: 3. série, Baby Buktu | When attacked in the jungle, Team Tennyson is saved by a toddler who looks eerily similar to Tim Buktu, but when they discover it really is a pint sized version of the nefarious globetrotter, Ben knows there's another threat looming.

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: 1. série, Take 10 | While trying to film his own indie film, Ben accidentally allows the Bug Gang to go free and when he takes the fight to their hidden lair, Ben has to take on their narcissistic leader the Ant Queen.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, Diving In The Wild | Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the last jar of Yummy chocolate spread in the cabin and it ends up sinking in the lagoon. The bear makes a diving suit from various home facilities, while the Lemmings share a diving tank to put a wrench in their adversary's flippers! But the local wildlife comes to meet them…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, Choco-Coco | Grizzy wakes up after a nap, starving, but the last jar of Yummy chocolate spread is empty. The cupboards are barren, except for a package of chocolate powder. Grizzy has the idea of mixing it with coconut milk. It's absolutely delicious! But the Lemmings, who are every bit as gluttonous, want their share of the choco-coco drink!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, Parasailing Fishing | Grizzy gets a nice big bite on the end of his fishing line. While he concentrates hard to strike his catch, the Lemmings divert the fish to tow them on a kite. Grizzy tries to sabotage their improvised kitesurfing game to recover what's rightfully his, until a shark's fin appears on the horizon!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, Yummy Pirates | The cupboards of the log cabin are hopelessly empty and Grizzy's belly is rumbling. Through his binoculars, he observes the overexcited Lemmings slipping all sorts of small metal objects into the slot of… a Yummy vending machine!?! The bear joins them on the pontoon. If only they could find some coins to make the machine work. Maybe the solution is to find the booty indicated on the treasure map they unearthed on the beach?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, Sea Excursion | After accidentally breaking his favorite sofa, Grizzy spots a cozy fishing cabin on a neighboring island. He requisitions the Lemmings' canoe to get there but discovers that the new cabin is dilapidated and lacking all comfort. The poor bear had been deluded by a poster. However, a fabulous yacht is moored nearby. It catches both his attention and that of the Lemmings, who have just disembarked on the island!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, Sand Lemmings | The Lemmings have fun taking potshots at sand statues depicting Grizzy. Outraged, he catapults them far into the distance. Grizzy takes advantage of their absence to erect a monumental sculpture of himself. But just as he takes a selfie in front of the sculpture, Grizzy realizes that the Lemmings have laid hands on… a pirate cannon!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, Non-Peaceful Coaching | After being hit over the head, the Lemmings become hypnotized by a fitness poster and take themselves for sports coaches. They are determined to forcefully train Grizzy, who would much rather lounge around than do push-ups and squats. But the Lemmings' new personality makes them particularly overbearing.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, Bear In Troubled Waters | Nothing seems to be biting Grizzy's fishing rod and the bear is in despair. Suddenly he spots a fabulous swordfish swimming in the lagoon. The bear is already licking his chops, when he sees the Lemmings straddling the fish in a rodeo game. From inside the cabin he uses as a mooring post, Grizzy manages to snare the swordfish and is about to pull it in, but the Lemmings are riding it toward the high seas. Each party tugs hard. And the cabin starts to slide…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, Earthquake-Proof Bear | The Lemmings discover that several drops of Tabasco sauce poured into a rock fault releases powerful sprays of steam that propel them high into the sky on a pot lid. Except that the entire volcanic island shudders each time the drops are poured. Grizzy, who has decided to take a nap in his hammock, confiscates the bottle before realizing that the Lemmings have an entire stock !

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, The Spirit Of Competition | The Lemmings have decided to organize a race with two sand yachts they found on the beach. The only thing missing, is a worthy adversary. They put Grizzy, who was taking a nap, on one of the yachts without waking him up. And the race is off. Grizzy wakes up in shock onboard his sand yacht.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, Odd-Job Crab | Grizzy has run out of ideas to open his coconut until he sees the Lemmings' new friend the crab open one with a simple snip of the claw. He confiscates the crustacean and uses it to take the tops off his coconuts. As they fight over the crab, the characters discover a remote-control device in a secret grotto that operates a giant crab. Grizzy takes over the controls, but the Lemmings want to play with the joystick too!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, Ordeal Of Comfort | A helicopter takes off from the beach, leaving behind installations for a TV game, namely lots of food supplies – which are locked up. To access the keys and the food, participants must win team tests under the surveillance of a drone. The Lemmings are the yellow team. The red team is comprised of Grizzy, an oar, and a flabbergasted crab!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, Outboard Cabin | While trying to avoid the Lemmings' outboard speedboat, Grizzy punctures his air mattress and is propelled into a hidden grotto where he finds a conch decorated with Maori symbols that can control whales. Grizzy returns, proudly straddling his cetacean and chases the Lemmings from his peaceful spot. But the Lemmings' imagination is equal to the size of this potential new playmate!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 3. série, Scrapper Cleans Up | Irma wants a romantic break; Bean doesn’t. It’s too expensive. Irma kidnaps Teddy and refuses to give him back unless Bean promises to take her to Paris. Caught between his inability to pay and his love of Teddy Bean doesn’t know what to do! Until he spots a cat beauty competition in which first prize is a romantic break in Paris – if only he can catch Scrapper …

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 3. série, Coach Trip | Bean wants to avoid lunch with Irma’s Mum at all costs. He persuades Mrs. Wicket to let him join her on a coach trip to a concert – but he has to disguise himself as an old-aged pensioner or he won’t be allowed on the coach. Once on the coach Bean drives everyone mad with his anti-boredom antics.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 3. série, Save That Tree | Bean is showing Irma his favourite tree in the park one day when he discovers a tree surgeon getting ready to cut it down. He darts up the tree and won’t come back down. Irma loves this new side of Bean-ey! The tree surgeon is frustrated and tries various ploys to get Bean down. But can Bean make it to the toilet without being discovered and still save that tree?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 3. série, For Sale | Mrs. Wicket is persuaded by a jaunty estate agent to put her house up for sale. Bean is distraught – where will he live? Not Mrs. Wicket’s problem. Bean decides to hi-jack the sales process in order to deter all potential buyers – even if it means turning the whole house upside down!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: 1. série, The People vs. Fred Jones | Fred stojí před soudem a je obviněn, že on sám byl strůjcem záhad, které vyřešil. S pomocí své obhájkyně Daphne se vrátíme do města, které bylo opuštěné po r. 1950 kvůli znečištění chemikáliemi a kde všechny terorizuje Toxický mutant.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: 2. série, Some Fred Time | In the season two premiere episode, the gang forces an over-worked Fred to relax and take time off from mysteries at Daphne's family's beach house. Unfortunately, when a walking shark attacks the ritzy beach community, the gang is forced to solve the mystery without Fred finding out about it.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show
programme.desc: 2. série, The Art of War | Rick's taken up painting to help him relax. Although he's warned them to stay out of his studio, Tom and Jerry inadvertently destroy his first painting. In an effort to reproduce it before he returns home, Tom and Jerry end up in a competition to prove who's the better artist. May the best Renoir win!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show
programme.desc: 2. série, Pillow Case | Unable to sleep because of the incessant barking from a dog somewhere in the city, Tom and Jerry must track down the noisy mutt. When they find the dog with the help of a friendly bat, they discover the pup can't sleep without her special pillow. Now, for the sake of everyone's sleep, the great pillow case is on!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show
programme.desc: 2. série, Home Insecurity | After Rick and Ginger install a high-tech, state-of-the-art home security system, Tom and Jerry's shenanigans activate the home's automation system. Using the system against each other, they quickly lose control and the house shuts them down.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show
programme.desc: 2. série, Tail of Two Kitties | Ginger accidentally backs her car over Butch's tail. Feeling awful, she brings the alley cat into her home until he's feeling better. Butch is finally getting what he's wanted, much to Tom's chagrin, especially now that Ginger's having him take care of the poor injured cat. Jerry revels in the situation until he realizes that two idiot cats are more trouble than one and Jerry's getting his butt whooped. Now Jerry must prove that Butch is rehabilitated in order to return him to the alley where he belongs and return his life.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show
programme.desc: 2. série, Vanishing Creamed | Hildie is mixing a batch of foot balm that'll soften and beautify her gnarly-looking feet. She has Tom rub it in, nice and good. Unfortunately, the foot balm is a little too strong and makes her foot disappear. Hildie's recipe may be a foot balm bomb but it gives Tom a good idea. He'll use it to "vanish" into thin air. Jerry literally doesn't know what hit him when the invisible cat bats him around like a ball of yarn. Tom is unaware when the effects begin to wear off and Jerry is able to defend himself. When Jerry gets a hold of the cream, it's his turn to have the upper hand. A battle of the vanishing cream ensues, each using it in various ways to outwit the other.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show
programme.desc: 2. série, Unhappily Harried After | It's Tom's wedding day! He's getting married to Toodles in a backyard wedding that we're experiencing through the eyes of his best friend, Jerry. Puuuuurfeeecttt in every way, then the crap hits the mouse hole: Tom is given Jerry as a wedding gift. When it can't possibly get worse Jerry wakes up and tosses Toodles out of the house!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Food Fight | Jerry is raiding the fridge but gets caught by Tom. Tom tries to get the food back, but Jerry and Tuffy fight back by throwing food at Tom. Jerry accidentally throws Tuffy at Tom and has to rescue him.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 2. série, Rat Trap | Mr Bean is very scared on a stormy night and even more so when he hears Mrs Wicket screaming from downstairs. Mr Bean investigates and finds the source of the problem...a rat! Mr Bean offers to help Mrs Wicket rid their house of the troublesome rodent. The only problem is the crafty rat is going nowhere fast and is always one step ahead. Mr Bean looks to inspiration from the Pied Piper but fairy stories don’t always have happy endings.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 2. série, Valentine's Bean | Mr Bean decides to do something romantic on Valentine’s Day for his long-suffering girlfriend Irma. But while he is secretly delivering her valentines card Mr Bean finds out he has a love rival for Irma’s attention. Bean steps up his efforts and takes Irma on a ‘date’ to the Valentine’s Fair only to find his love rival is there too! But will the fortune-teller’s prediction be the ticket to a happy ending?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 2. série, All You Can Eat | Mr Bean has forgotten he's supposed to be cooking dinner for his long-suffering girlfriend Irma. He dashes to the supermarket to buy some groceries but why buy food when you can win an entire trolley full in an All You Can Eat Competition? But Mr Bean has some stiff competition - no one can eat one of Mr Magg’s pies quicker than Mr Maggs himself. Mr Bean has to think fast to win. But after all that eating will Bean still be in the mood to cook a romantic meal?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 1. série, Art thief | During a visit to London's National Gallery, Bean witnesses the theft of a major work of art. Bloodhound that he is, he pursues the culprit across the Channel to Paris only to be waylaid by a Reliant Robin, a traffic jam, and a mime artist under the Eiffel Tower. Will Mr Bean ‘the International Art Sleuth’ prove successful?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 1. série, Scaredy Bean | Who's afraid of daft films about giant killer cats, blobs from outer space and thumb-size men who dance around in sugar bowls? Mr. Bean is. He's very afraid. A trip to the cinema makes Mr. Bean’s imagination play tricks on him.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 2. série, Flat Pack | Mr Bean is in need of a sturdy new bookcase and sets off to visit a furniture warehouse. He finds one that’s perfect but is outraged when he’s told he has to build the bookcase himself! Bean is unfamiliar with flat pack assembly and struggles to construct his new bookcase failing miserably when he discovers he’s one screw short. Mr Bean heads back to the shop only to find it’s closed!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 2. série, Holiday Teddy | Mr Bean decides to take Teddy on holiday to the seaside. But when he arrives at his hotel a spoilt little girl wants Teddy all for herself. And her protective dad only wants the best for his ‘princess’. An on-going tussle ensues between Mr Bean the little girl and her Dad resulting in a chase across the seaside town and onto the pier. No one comes between Mr Bean Teddy and their ‘relaxing’ holiday!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Rainbow Candy Shop | Tom is taking selfies and enjoying a sweet snack at the candy shop, when Jerry and Tuffy sneak up and eat his strawberries. Tom proceeds to chase after them, but Tuffy falls into the claw machine. Jerry tries to save him, and Tom fishes them out. Tom makes Tuffy cry and apologizes by feeding him sweets.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Picnic takes all | The baby lemmings are having a picnic but have a nasty tendency to get raspberry juice all over themselves. When one of the baby lemmings dirties baby Raccoon, who has just finished washing up, baby Raccoon decides to take matters into his own hands and wash them. But the baby lemmings get dirty immediately! Baby Raccoon decides to teach them some manners!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Down to the Wire | The Baby Lemmings meet a spider and his web, which allows them to play like baby Spider-Man. They even develop a tree climbing course in the forest. Baby Beaver, for his part, has a hard time fitting branches together to build a bridge over the river. When he sees the construction possibilities offered by the lemmings' spider, he decides to steal it from them.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Nightlight Fireflies | The Baby Lemmings discover that blowing into a leaf makes sounds that light up and even make fireflies dance! Meanwhile, the cowardly and tired Baby Moose is looking for a place to sleep. But as soon as the moon gets hidden, his fear of the dark makes him tremble and prevents him from getting any sleep. When he spots the Baby Lemmings' fireflies, he decides to capture them to make a nightlight.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: 1. série, 17. díl - Na den Betpočítačem | When Batcomputer shuts down for a system update, the other Batwheels must take over for her while aiding Batman in a battle against Harley Quinn.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: 1. série, 18. díl - Všude dobře, doma nejlíp | MOE wants to know what it's like to be a member of the Batwheels, but the bot gets more than he bargained for when Bam invites him along for an exciting mission to stop Poison Ivy.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels
programme.desc: 1. série, A Joking Matter | A musical montage features the Joker, Gotham's most prickling prankster, as he causes trouble big and small for Batman, the Batwheels, and Gothamites alike!

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: 3. série, Them's Fightin' Words! | Team Tennyson discovers a Hartfield-McJoy reenactment in the cornfield next door, but when Hex resurrects the ghosts of the real feuding families, Ben must find a way to bring them together if he is to save the day!

programme.title: Ben 10

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: 2. série, Some Fred Time | In the season two premiere episode, the gang forces an over-worked Fred to relax and take time off from mysteries at Daphne's family's beach house. Unfortunately, when a walking shark attacks the ritzy beach community, the gang is forced to solve the mystery without Fred finding out about it.

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: 3. série, Witch | Lamput takes refuge in a spooky castle on the hill. The Docs, hot on Lamput's heels, find an unattended broomstick, and, typically, their first instinct is to use it to try to squish their orange quarry. But they quickly discover the broomstick has other, way cooler, uses. Before long the Docs are engaged in some high-speed, unlicenced magical broomstick-riding. Luckily for Lamput, the castle's owner steps in. She's green and witchy, and pretty annoyed about being disturbed from her moonbaking. When the docs break her magical broom, she flies into full witch-mode. Everyone gets transformed into frogs. Which, for Lamput, is a normal day at the office.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 3. série, Running on Empty | Mr Bean is on his way to the seaside when the mini runs out of petrol. Undeterred he manages to get a push but for some reason the do-gooders don’t want to push him all the way to the beach! Instead he uses wind power piggy backs on a car transporter and 802harnesses up some horses to try and get to his destination.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 3. série, Bean Bug | Scrapper gives Bean fleas and Bean is forced to call in the pest control person. His flat will take 24 hours to fumigate. Bean begs Mrs. Wicket to let him stay with her. She agrees as long as Bean helps her with cooking cleaning etc. 24 hours later and Bean is desperate to see the back of her. The feeling is mutual. But then Mrs. Wicket starts itching …

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series

Hundreds of angry amphibians decide to invite themselves as well. Bean proves to be no expert at catching slippery green things that won’t stop hopping about all over the blinking place.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 3. série, Coffee Bean | Mr. Bean is out shopping when it starts to rain. Taking refuge in a trendy coffee bar Bean is fascinated both by the brewing machinery and the amount of money people will pay for small cups of coffee! Scenting a fortune to be made Bean opens up his own strange successful coffee bar …

programme.title: Baby Lemmings

As for the baby lemmings, they've discovered the principle of the slide and are having fun building a longer and longer one. When the baby chipmunk sees this, she sees a great opportunity to get her nuts down more cheaply.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Roly-Bowling | The Baby Lemmings knock down one of Baby Beaver's constructions, bowling style. He immediately gets angry and sends the lemmings off to play further away. But he soon runs out of branches for his construction. While he is looking for new ones, he notices that the Baby Lemmings have collected all the beautiful branches in the area to build a natural bowling alley! Baby beaver wants to take their branches, but the Baby Lemmings won't let him!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Instant Sticking | The Baby Lemmings accidentally discover how to make syrup flow from the trunk of a maple tree. It's a strangely sticky substance that can be used to invent all kinds of games! Their neighbour, Baby Raccoon, who is a real stickler for cleanliness, thinks they should get rid of the stuff, which collects leaves and dust and sticks everywhere, otherwise the forest and its lair will never be spotless!

programme.title: Ben 10

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: 2. série, Bomzobo Lives | During a routine trip to the DMV, Max takes a driving test to renew his license, but when a disguised Zombozo hijacks the role of instructor, Ben goes alien to stop the baddie and save their family road trip.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: 1. série, The People vs. Fred Jones | Fred stojí před soudem a je obviněn, že on sám byl strůjcem záhad, které vyřešil. S pomocí své obhájkyně Daphne se vrátíme do města, které bylo opuštěné po r. 1950 kvůli znečištění chemikáliemi a kde všechny terorizuje Toxický mutant.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 1. série, Sofa | Cat-SittingMr. Bean při dovádění na žehlícím prkně coby surfařském prkně, těžce zraní paní Wicketovou, která musí být převezena do nemocnice. O jejího domácího mazlíčka se nyní nemá kdo postarat a tak veškerá péče zůstává na Beanovi. Ten si doteď neuvědomoval, jak náročná je péče o rozmazleného domácího mazlíčka.The BottleMr. Beana zaujme v obchodě starožitná láhev s lodičkou uvnitř. Před domem však nemůže nalézt klíče od domu a tak lahev postaví na zem vedle prázdné lahve od mléka. Lahev s lodičkou si však nevědomky odveze muž rozvážející mléko a Beanovi nezbývá nic jiného než se za ním vydat.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 2. série, What a load of Rubbish | Mr Bean is tidying his flat and chucking out a load of old unwanted junk. Unfortunately during the big clear out Teddy accidentally falls into a bin bag which gets put out in the street. Bean is horrified when the rubbish van arrives and he realises that dear old Teddy is now on his way to the landfill. Bean races across town to the dump but how will he ever find his friend amongst all the mountains of junk?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 2. série, The Robot | Mr Bean buys a robot to clean his flat but it ends up trashing half the town.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 2. série, Ice Cream | Mr Bean wants an ice cream from the ice cream van. But by the time he gets to the front of the queue the ice-cream man has gone to lunch. Bean takes it upon himself to climb through in an open window and into the back of the van from where he starts to help himself. Unfortunately he soon attracts a crowd and is forced to serve a long queue of kids until all the ice cream runs out. When the ice-cream man comes back from lunch and drives away he is unaware that Bean is still hiding in the back of his van en route to the ice cream factory.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Fish Bowl / At the Cinema / Coffee Shop | Tom has Jerry and Tuffy trapped in a fish bowl. / Tom is at the movies, Jerry and Tuffy pop out of his bucket of popcorn. / At a coffee shop, Jerry and Tuffy are eating a strawberry cake.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, Thermal Lemmings | By chance, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a container filled with metal survival food flasks. Primarily filled with vegetables, they do not find favor with the bear, who is more interested in the hi-tech equipment at the rear of the container. Behind his back, the Lemmings find a flask of Yummy and skedaddle with it. But how will they escape Grizzy equipped with his sophisticated gear?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, Substitute Egg | In a trunk, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a big chocolate egg with a surprise inside. They are licking their lips. As they fight, they accidentally send the coveted egg flying amidst a group of penguins where a couple of winged creatures adopt it. They sit on the egg as if it were their offspring. Not intimidated, Grizzy and the Lemmings decide to get their hands on it, but the entire bird colony intervenes.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, Lemmings Constellation | The Lemmings open a nightclub with blasting music and a disco ball in an igloo they have built not far from the cabin. The noise prevents Grizzy from sleeping. The bear confiscates the disco ball and propels the Lemmings far into the distance. They land in an ice cave where they discover a console that lights up the stars in the sky and controls the northern lights. The canopy of heaven starts blinking. The Lemmings transform the ice field into an open-air discotheque!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, Spinning Lemmings | The Lemmings come up with a ride worthy of a county fair in the living room. Awakened, Grizzy throws their juice extractor out the window and the rodents land in the neighboring science station where they accidentally wake up… a mammoth! A friendship is born between them. The Lemmings drag the mastodon into their game, and he transforms the entire cabin into a Ferris Wheel. Grizzy, who was trying to doze in peace, wakes up in a panic.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, Polar Super Star | Before an audience of penguins and walruses, two teams of Lemmings perform acrobatic high jumps, competing for the winning prize. When Grizzy accidentally jumps in, he quickly gets caught up in the game and the clapometer goes wild! Intoxicated by his victory, the bear is by no means a modest winner! But the Lemmings want their moment of glory in the limelight as well!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, My Friend The Penguin | While Grizzy fishes, a penguin comes over and sees that the bear's bucket is empty. He decides to help him and catches piles of fish. Impressed, the bear brings the penguin back to the cabin, where a friendship rapidly strikes up. This pleasant and friendly new companion quickly arouses the Lemmings' curiosity. They lure the penguin away on the sly and replace him with another one who's not nearly as clever. Grizzy will quickly see through the trickery.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 3. série, Thermal Shock! | Just as Grizzy settles into the couch by the fireside, the Lemmings come charging into the living room on their new mount, the vacuum cleaner. Irritated, the bear throws the mechanical charger into the fireplace, which blows up. Freezing air sweeps into the cabin. Seeking a source of heat, Grizzy decides to move into the science station greenhouse where the temperature is controlled by a drone. But the bear is unaware of what he carries in his luggage: the Lemmings!

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: 1. série, 37. díl - Povolení žertovat | When Redbird tries his hand at espionage as “V-8, the Super-Spy”, he quickly realizes he's gotten in over his head, so Redbird teams up with Bibi to save the Amusement Mile from Dr. Spy!

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: 1. série, 38. díl - Starý Batmobil | Bibi has a terrible no-good day after she keeps messing up and lets Joker get away. She doesn’t think he can help Batgirl anymore, but a “bad today” doesn’t mean it’ll be a “bad tomorrow".

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: 1. série, 39. díl - Tryskáč na suchu | After refusing to practice with her new underwater mode, Batwing is unable to save Batman from Penguin's sunken ship trap. The Batwheels must help Wing practice her submersible skills before she can save the day.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: 1. série, 40. díl - Velká výměna vozů | After agreeing to swap motherboards and change bodies, the Batwheels have to quickly learn to “drive a mile in each other’s wheels” in time to stop the approaching Legion of Zoom!

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders
programme.desc: 2. série, Polar Plunge | Pro snowboarder Pepper Polar Bear hires The Looney Builders to build a ski resort. Pepper soon learns that others have different skill levels.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders
programme.desc: 2. série, This Sand is Your Sand | Wile E. Coyote hires The Looney Builders to build him a house in the desert so he can be alone. The Road Runner tries to pay him a visit causing Wile E. to heighten his security measures.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders
programme.desc: 2. série, Fire Fighters | The Looney Builders are hired by the town’s volunteer firefighters to build a fire truck. Duty calls and they build on the go as they make rescues throughout Looneyburg.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders
programme.desc: 2. série, Beignet Day | Zaida Gator hires The Looney Builders to build her a boat so she can share her beignets in the swamp. She soon realizes there are others to share with elsewhere and enlists the crew to make it possible.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 1. série, Hot Date | Against his better judgement, Bean has agreed to go out on a proper date with Irma Gobb, his girlfriend. She has the perfect evening planned: a romantic film followed by a candlelit dinner for two. If only she had the perfect boyfriend to go with it.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 1. série, Wanted | Mistaken for an escaped convict, Bean is carted off to jail where he finds that, with a little imagination, prison can be quite nice actually. The real convict finds life less cosy under the thumb of Mr. Bean’s landlady.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 4. série, Arcade Trouble | Mr Bean and Teddy are enjoying a day at the arcade, when Mr Bean gets carried away with the dance machine, knocking Teddy onto the floor. Teddy’s picked up, put on a trolley of stuffed toys and figurines – and soon enough, he’s been put in the claw machine as a prize! Mr Bean has run out of coins, so has to find a way of winning Teddy back without looking like he’s cheating!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: 4. série, Alarm Bean | Mr Bean and Teddy are looking forward to seeing a once-in-a-lifetime comet – but it won’t appear until 4am! He tries to stay up, but it’s useless – he keeps dropping off. So instead, Mr Bean decides to go to bed and set an alarm – yet he over-winds the clock and it breaks! With all the shops closed, his only option is to build his own complicated version to make sure he doesn’t miss the comet…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 4. série, Pirates in Sight | The Lemmings play pirates on a beached boat. Grizzy, who is fishing further down, realizes that with the Lemmings’ boat, he could come closer to a zone that’s teeming with fish. Grizzy takes a malicious pleasure playing pirate himself to unseat the Lemmings and steal their boat. The Lemmings discover a chest containing real pirate belongings. A telescope conjures the owner’s ghost who immediately places his saber and hook at their disposal.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 4. série, Crab Basket | Grizzy sets sail with his fishing gear. But he has no intention of fishing: it's a scheme to enjoy a jar of Yummy chocolate spread alone in peace. The Lemmings sense the subterfuge and sink his boat to get the treat, which sinks to the ocean depths. The characters dive in pursuit and discover a school of intelligent crabs that live in an underwater city. Their treasure is a substance that’s even yummier than Yummy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 4. série, Grizzy’s Odyssey | The Lemmings find the cabin upside down. Upon closer inspection, it looks like an epic battle took place there. And Grizzy isn't here. The curious Lemmings start imagining what could have happened, visualizing the most improbable scenes for us. They decide to follow their lead to find Grizzy and confirm their zany theories.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 4. série, Flying Sands | Grizzy dreams of drinking some nice cold coconut milk on the couch. Step one, get rid of the Lemmings who are having fun flying through the living room. Two, find coconuts that haven't been emptied of their nectar. While Grizzy struggles to pick coconuts that are too high up, the Lemmings find a magic conch. By simply dusting yourself with its sand, you can fly! It doesn't take Grizzy long to figure this out and the bear rapidly imagines himself as Peter Pan sipping on his easily-harvested coconut milk.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 4. série, Symphony for Lemmings | Grizzy wants to watch TV in peace. The Lemmings have other plans: they want to have fun playing music with homemade instruments. Exasperated by the racket they're making in the garage, Grizzy destroys the instruments and sends the Lemmings flying. The Lemmings discover a magic ukulele that bewitches anyone who hears its music: the perfect tool to regain control of the cabin and get back to their concert.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 4. série, Interplanetary Cabin | Grizzy can't sleep because it's too hot. He decides to confiscate the fans the Lemmings use to power their fake spaceship. Totally into their Space Opera game, the Lemmings try to repel the alien Grizzy with "laser" party favors and are propelled onto an "unknown planet": a volcano crater with a secret base where a rocket is ready to take off. The rocket carries the cabin into space. It's no longer a game: Grizzy and the Lemmings will have to face the dangers of outer space!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 4. série, Termitator | Grizzy uses insecticide and a fly swatter to get rid of vermin that are bothering him during his siesta. The Lemmings heal his last victim: a cute little insect they adopt as their house pet. Only problem, their starving mascot only eats wood! The cabin has lots of it, but when Grizzy realizes that an insect is eating his home from the inside, he takes drastic measures to eliminate it permanently.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 4. série, Dad Despite Himself | Grizzy is too hot and proposes the Lemmings an exchange: their ventilator, which they use to propel their skateboard in the air, for a baby ostrich Grizzy found outside the cabin and who can tow them. The Lemmings are delighted to play with their new baby friend who is overflowing with energy. But the baby’s parents have a different outlook and do not want their son taking risks. Thinking that Grizzy is the Lemmings’ father, they hold him accountable.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 4. série, Illuminated Lemmings | Grizzy has played for too many hours on the console. His eyes are so fatigued he cannot stand a single ray of light. The Lemmings choose this very moment to throw a big birthday party with as many lights as possible! Grizzy goes to great lengths to settle the issue and decides to trip the power supply. The Lemmings discover a source of magical light deep in the savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: 4. série, Hide-n-Seek Lemmings | Grizzy watches the Lemmings play Hide-n-Seek and cannot refrain from sabotaging their game by revealing their hiding places. The Lemmings challenge him to play against them. The two sides outdo each other in cunning and trickery, but they are equally good. For the last decisive round, the opponents decide to extend the game zone to the entire savanna.

programme.title: Hvězdy stříbrného plátna
programme.desc: Hvězdy stříbrného plátna | Walter Matthau. Podivný pár, Apartmá v hotelu Plaza či Dennis – postrach okolí aneb nezapomenutelný šarm amerického herce. Britský dokumentární cyklus

programme.title: Exilová čítanka
programme.desc: Exilová čítanka | Mohamedou Ould Slahi Houbeini. Portrét mauritánského autora, který románově zpracoval své zážitky ze čtrnáctiletého věznění v Guantánamu. Režie I. Grófová

programme.title: Ladí neladí
programme.desc: Ladí neladí | Sunflower Caravan (CZ) a Appendix (SK): odborníci žasnou, chválí a doporučují. Budou obě kapely stejně příjemným objevem i pro vás? (2007). Hudebně diskusní pořad o české a slovenské populární hudbě uvádějí P. Fiala a M. Kaščák

programme.title: Na chalupě Austrálie
programme.desc: 1. série, Na chalupě Austrálie | Hugh Fearnley-Whittingstall před mnoha a mnoha lety začal s experimentováním pod dvojheslem udržitelný vývoj a sebezásobování. Odstěhoval se na chalupu v Dorsetu a pustil se do pěstitelské a chovatelské činnosti. Hugh nyní tento experiment a vzkaz přesvědčeného samozásobitele veze na malý jižní kontinent. Předává štafetu svému australskému kolegovi, tasmánskému kuchaři Paulu Westovi, který tak musí zápolit s novými výzvami.

programme.title: Monty Don: Americké rajské zahrady
programme.desc: 1. série, Monty Don: Americké rajské zahrady | Americká rajská zahrada? Co to znamená? Existuje vůbec? A pokud ano, jak vypadá? V tomto třídílném seriálu si výše uvedené otázky klade Monty Don a odpovědi hledá na celém povrchu obrovitého kontinentu. První zastávkou na jeho pouti je nádherně rozkvetlá prérie – nefalšovaná americká divočina hýřící barevnými květy. Potom se připojí ke skupně dobrovolníků, kteří pro sebe a pro veřejnost budují společnou zahradu v New Yorku, a zblízka se podívá, jaké výsledky může přinést americké odhodlání „já dokážu cokoli” v kombinaci s bezednými finančními zdroji. Cestou na jih Monty zjišťuje, jak vypadaly americké zahrady v období krátce po vyhlášení nezávislosti a nestačí obdivovat obří duby v New Orleans. Na sklonku svého transkontinentálního výletu ještě zamíří na západní pobřeží, do zvláštní krajiny zpestřené kaktusy a kalifornskými sekvojemi, kde se setká s několika celebritami. programme.title: Klub mistrů zahradníků
programme.desc: 1. série, Klub mistrů zahradníků | V tomto zbrusu novém seriálu Alan Titchmarsh a jeho pestrý tým odborníků odhalují nejnovější zahradnické trendy a zahrady inovativního rázu na celém území Spojeného království, přičemž budoucí, dosud neotrkané, ale i zkušené zahradníky zahrnou praktickými radami a tipy. Skupinu Alanových expertů tvoří David Domoney, zahradní inženýrka Camilla Bassett-Smith, komunitní zahradník Tayshan Hayden-Smith, ekozahradnice Anna Greenland a odbornice na pokojové rostliny Sarah Gerrard-Jones.

programme.title: Od farmáře na talíř s Markétou Hrubešovou
programme.desc: 1. série, 6. díl | Markéta žije ve městě, ale má venkovské kořeny; dobře zná všechny kouty české metropole, ale jakmile je to jen trochu možné, čerpá nové síly na vsi, v lesích a mezi chalupami. V seriálu “Od farmáře na talíř” se s ní podíváme přesně do těch míst, která jsou pro ni důležitá. A to znamená, že vedle vysoké profesní úrovně máme zaručenou i osobní věrohodnost a upřímnost.

programme.title: Dřevem žije celá Británie
programme.desc: 3. série, Dřevem žije celá Británie | Tento seriál je oslavou krásy dřeva a šikovnosti truhlářů, kteří se dřevem pracují. Mel Giedroyc drží v ruce klíč od báječně vybavené dílny, která se skrývá v hloubi waleských lesů. Deset z nejambicióznějších truhlářů Spojeného království se k němu připojí, aby mezi sebou v řemeslném zápase rozhodli, kdo je oprávněn obdržet titul Nejlepší britský truhlář.

programme.title: Velkolepé plány - ulice
programme.desc: 3. série, Velkolepé plány - ulice | Kevin McCloud sleduje rodiny, které na sebe vzaly heroický úkol stavby vlastního domova. Ba co víc, tito lidé v rámci realizace největšího anglického projektu v kategorii svépomocného stavění vytvoří celé nové ulice.

programme.title: Místo zlého snu vysněný domov
programme.desc: 1. série, Vypotit se | Drew a Jonathan Scottovi se svými vynikajícími renovačními schopnostmi spěchají na pomoc zoufalým majitelům domů, aby jim pomohli zvládnout zdánlivě neřešitelné výzvy, s kterými doma bojují a které jim denně přerůstají přes hlavu. Stěhování nepřichází v úvahu, a tak je rekonstrukce často spojená s bouřlivými emocemi, protože dvojčata Drew a Jonathan se snaží co nejlépe odstranit závažné problémy, s nimiž majitelé zatím musí žít, i když je to pro ně utrpení, a doufají, že se jim podaří vytvořit pohodlný domov, který si daná rodina znovu zamiluje.

programme.desc: Pomalé vaření | Gordon Ramsay vařil v nejrůznějších profesionálních kuchyních déle než 25 let. Učil se od několika nejlepších šéfkuchařů světa – a několik nejlepších šéfkuchařů světa také sám vychoval. Ve svém nejnovějším seriálu hodí za hlavu své obvyklé úsilí o komplexitu a tvrdý dril a místo toho nám ukáže, jak vařit lehce a zábavně, a přesto dobře. Tento seriál chce hlavně všem kuchařům a kuchařinkám, kteří to zkoušejí doma, poskytnout naději, upevnit sebedůvěru a vnuknout isnpiraci, ať už do kuchyně vstupují s obavami, nebo s přesvědčením, že všechno zvládnou. Gordon nám předvede několik moderních receptů a postupů – a my se budeme divit, že jsme na ně nepřišli sami... Nenechte si ujít jednoho z nejlepších mistrů kuchařů naší doby a jeho televizní kurz. Lákavá jídla – jak je umí jenom on

programme.title: To je prostě Jamie
programme.desc: To je prostě Jamie | Jamie zhušťuje domácí vaření do pouhých čtyř jednoduchých kroků, a tak dovede moderní kulinářské umění k jeho prapůvodním základům. Nabídne nám jednoduché a chutné nápady, díky kterým si můžeme osvojit vaření a pečení pro všední den. Jamie vyzbrojí zkušené i začínající kuchaře dobrými recepty – a sebedůvěrou –, takže se mohou blýsknout jídly skutečně domáckého rázu, která jsou právě tak dobrá jako jednoduchá

programme.title: Luca vaří italsky
programme.desc: Amaretti | Připravte se na další vzrušující dobrodružství v nové sezóně, ve které vás šéfkuchař Luca Ciano zavede hlouběji do srdce italské kuchyně. V této řadě si Luca zachovává styl, který se stal jeho poznávacím znamením: tradici mísí s inovací a současně vzdává poctu chuťové pestrosti Itálie i Austrálie

programme.title: Britské dobrodružství Jamese Martina
programme.desc: Birmingham | Povzbuzen úspěchem svých francouzských a amerických dobrodružství se James Martin opět vydává na cesty. Tentokrát si však usmyslel, že zmapuje zemi ležící trochu blíže jeho domovu, Velkou Británii. Se svými přáteli procestuje celé Skotsko, Anglii, Wales a Severní Irsko. Dobrodružná britská pouť Jamese Martina je zážitkem na celý život, zpestřeným vynikajícími pochoutkami a fantastickými kuchařskými recepty

programme.title: Recept na každý den s Mary Berryovou
programme.desc: Chutné památky | V tomto seriálu nám Mary Berry předvede naprosto všední pokrmy a jejich ingredience, do kterých je odjakživa zamilovaná, ráda je připravuje, respektive používá. Mary nám tak dokáže, že vůbec nepotřebujeme nějaké zvláštní suroviny a nemusíme mít v hlavě celý repertoár kuchařského mistra, abychom se svými vlastními jídly dobře a chutně najedli. Mary nám ukáže jednoduchá řešení a prozradí pár tajných triků, abychom sami viděli, jak je snadné zkrášlit všední dny všedními jídly změněnými v nevšední mistrovská díla

programme.title: Od farmáře na talíř s Pepou Nemravou
programme.desc: Pomalu ale jistě: šnečí lahůdky z farmy Vlkoš | Kulinářské dobrodružství s Pepou Nemravou začíná! V každém díle navštívíme jinou farmu, kde poznáte dřinu i radost, zajímavé příběhy, ale hlavně skvělé suroviny. Ty pak Pepa promění v klasické české pokrmy, na které se vám budou sbíhat sliny. Od vidlí až po vidličku - skutečná chuť Čech a Moravy!

programme.title: Hladoví motorkáři - Kuře nebo vejce
programme.desc: USA | Novou misí hladovějících motorkářů je nalezení nejlepších kuřecích a vaječných receptů světa. Chlapci na svých jednostopých vozidlech vyrážejí do Evropy na Blízký východ a do Ameriky, přičemž nás seznámí s neuvěřitelně všestrannými možnostmi využití kuřecího masa a vajíček.

programme.title: Gino: Maminčina kuchyně
programme.desc: Torre Del Greco | Gino D'Acampo, který se naučil péci pizzu a na sporém ohni pomalu vařit ragú od babičky Flory, vyjíždí na cestu, jež by měla spojit několik generací jeho rozvětvené rodiny. Procestuje Itálii a pěje ódy na ženy, které se vždy uměly postarat o plné mísy a pohodu rodinného stolu a po řadu století formovaly gastronomii Ginovy rodné země. Nejprve navštíví místo, kde všechno začalo: Torre del Greco v Neapoli, kde se v kuchyni své babičky a maminky naučil vařit. Mezi dalšími zastaveními na jeho pouti figuruje i Florencie a Bologna. Tam ochutná lokální pochutiny připravované matkami tamějších rodin.

programme.title: Raymond Blanc a královské kuchyňské zahrady
programme.desc: Highgrove 2 | Světoznámý šéfkuchař Raymond Blanc zve diváky na podzim letošního roku do nejúžasnějších královských kuchyňských zahrad ve Velké Británii.V rámci desetidílného seriálu navštíví Raymond Blanc, držitel mnoha ocenění, pět britských královských kuchyňských zahrad. Díky jedinečnému přístupu do těchto úchvatných prostor, setkání s lidmi, kteří v nich pracují, a šéfkuchaři, kteří je využívají, zavede Raymond Blanc diváky za zeď do některých dosud neviděných kulinářských celků. od jablečných tunelů v Highgrove až po zahrady zámku Mey provoněné mořskou tříští Královské kuchyňské zahrady Raymonda Blanca slibují být fascinující kulinářskou exkurzí, během níž objevíte rozmanité ingredience a nové způsoby pěstování, vaření a stravování.

programme.title: Billovy chutné víkendy
programme.desc: Norfolk | Od nynějška můžeme každý týden sledovat Billa na jeho gastronomických víkendech, které se příliš nepodobají tomu, na co jsme běžně zvyklí. Billovy recepty se vyznačují neobvyklou rychlostí a jednoduchostí, ale přesto jimi potěšíme třeba i větší rodinnou nebo společenskou sešlost. Základem jsou vyždycky suroviny čerstvě nakoupené na trhu, jakož i onen příslovečný „šmrnc”, který je neoddělitelnou součástí Billova profesního rukopisu. Ať už se Bill objeví kdekoli, dokáže z lokální nabídky surovin připravit něco obdivuhodného. Sliny se sbíhají, oči přecházejí – a to dělá z Billovy show nenapodobitelnou událost. Nezajímá ho, že bude mít špinavé ruce, loupe brambory, míchá sardinkovou pomazánku, jen aby pro nás udělal to nejlepší.

programme.title: To je prostě Jamie
programme.desc: To je prostě Jamie | Jamie zhušťuje domácí vaření do pouhých čtyř jednoduchých kroků, a tak dovede moderní kulinářské umění k jeho prapůvodním základům. programme.title: Nadiya pro všední den
programme.desc: Ve slavnostním hávu | Nadiya Hussain považuje za svoje poslání okořenit naše každodenní jídla trochou vzrušení a je přesvědčená, že nejlepší způsob, jak to provést, se zakládá na inspirujících receptech a řadě neotřelých triků, díky kterým budou jídla, až je poneseme na stůl, mnohem chutnější. V monotématických epizodách se budou probírat jídla hřející na duši, jídla čerstvá a zdravá, ale i pochoutky pro zvláštní příležitosti. A Nadiya se pokusí naše chuťové pohárky jaksepatří unavit. Vyzkouší s námi všechny možné chutě: kyselou, sladkou, ostrou, hořkou, pikantní, hedvábně lahodnou, zemitou, ořechového charakteru... Snaží se žádnou nevynechat. Ve svém novém seriálu, nad kterým se nám budou sbíhat sliny, Nadiya divákům jednak vysvětlí, jak jednotlivé kombinace chutí fungují, jednak nám předvede, jak důležitou roli hrají chutě při vyvolávání různých pocitů a nostalgickém vzpomínání. Během vaření nám odhalí i několik vzpomínek a příběhů z vlastního života.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge vaří Španělsko
programme.desc: Česnek a hrozny | Šéfkuchař Tom Kerridge se opět vydává na cesty, tentokrát je jeho cílem Španělsko, kde se setkává s pěstiteli, kteří produkují potraviny a ingredience se stejným zanícením, s jakým je on jako kuchař vaří. Se svým unikántním staromódním food truckem navštíví šest okouzlujících španělských regionů, od Kantábrie po Andalusii a od Katalánska po Extremaduru, aby mohl objevovat plodiny, které danou oblast udržují při životě.

programme.title: Od farmáře na talíř s Pepou Nemravou
programme.desc: Jak se stříhá kněževeský micro poklad | Kulinářské dobrodružství s Pepou Nemravou začíná! V každém díle navštívíme jinou farmu, kde poznáte dřinu i radost, zajímavé příběhy, ale hlavně skvělé suroviny. Ty pak Pepa promění v klasické české pokrmy, na které se vám budou sbíhat sliny. Od vidlí až po vidličku - skutečná chuť Čech a Moravy!

programme.title: Tak to dělá Nigella
programme.desc: Tak to dělá Nigella | V tomto fantastickém šestidílném seriálu nás Nigella zasvětí do tajemství své kuchyně. Uvidíme mnoho nových pochutin, dozvíme se, jaké ingredience má kuchařka nejraději a jaké osobní vazby ji k jednotlivým receptům poutají. Zatímco budeme hloubat nad tím, nakolik se stolování prolíná všedním životem každého člověka, Nigella nám předvede řadu lákavých receptů, například bhurtu s rybími prsty, jemný moučník s čokoládou a oříškovým máslem, vynikající makaróny s krabím masem a sýrem a nesmírně jednoduché, a přesto mile hřejivé rybí ragú.

programme.title: James Martin - doma v kuchyni
programme.desc: Levné a veselé | James Martin se ve vlastní kuchyni podělí s diváky o své recepty, vysloveně domácího charakteru, a o všelijaké tajné metody a praktiky, kterými žádná správná hospodyňka nikdy nepohrdne. Pokrmy domácí kuchyně se obvykle nevyznačují elegantním vzhledem, bylo by zpozdilé čekat od nich nějakou pastvu pro oči, ale jednou věcí si buďme jisti: dokud má vařečku v ruce James, najíme se velice chutně.

programme.title: Jak chutná venkov
programme.desc: Jak chutná venkov | Mnozí sníme o tom, že se odstěhujeme na venkov, budeme pěstovat vlastní zeleninu, budeme chovat zvířata a podstatně více času strávíme v přírodě. Kdo to přesně takhle udělal, to je například bývalý londýnský kuchař Julius Roberts. V jeho hřejivém seriálu uvidíme, jak prožíval svoje první léto na malé, idylické dorsetské usedlosti.

Zatímco budeme hloubat nad tím, nakolik se stolování prolíná všedním životem každého člověka, Nigella nám předvede řadu lákavých receptů, například bhurtu s rybími prsty, jemný moučník s čokoládou a oříškovým máslem, vynikající makaróny s krabím masem a sýrem a nesmírně jednoduché, a přesto mile hřejivé rybí ragú.

programme.title: Nadiya snadno a rychle
programme.desc: Recepty, když je málo času | Nadiya Hussain nás nyní zásobí řadou užitečných kuchyňských triků, díky kterým ušetříme spoustu času. Předvede nám jednoduché, avšak velice chutné recepty, abychom sami viděli, že vynikající jídla nebo cukroví domácího charakteru dokáže připravit každý, i ten, kdo má velice pestrý nebo příliš komplikovaný život. Svým pořadem se snaží pomoci těm, kdo žijí hekticky a nevědí dne ani hodiny: hasičům, řidičům tiráků a zaměstnaným rodičům bojujícím s nedostatkem času. Kromě nich se setká s odborníky z potravinářského průmyslu, kteří vyrábějí její oblíbené časově úsporné ingredience.

programme.title: Recept na každý den s Mary Berryovou
programme.desc: Hutně a srdečně | V tomto seriálu nám Mary Berry předvede naprosto všední pokrmy a jejich ingredience, do kterých je odjakživa zamilovaná, ráda je připravuje, respektive používá. Mary nám tak dokáže, že vůbec nepotřebujeme nějaké zvláštní suroviny a nemusíme mít v hlavě celý repertoár kuchařského mistra, abychom se svými vlastními jídly dobře a chutně najedli. Mary nám ukáže jednoduchá řešení a prozradí pár tajných triků, abychom sami viděli, jak je snadné zkrášlit všední dny všedními jídly změněnými v nevšední mistrovská díla.

programme.title: James Martin - doma v kuchyni
programme.desc: Levné a veselé | James Martin se ve vlastní kuchyni podělí s diváky o své recepty, vysloveně domácího charakteru, a o všelijaké tajné metody a praktiky, kterými žádná správná hospodyňka nikdy nepohrdne. Pokrmy domácí kuchyně se obvykle nevyznačují elegantním vzhledem, bylo by zpozdilé čekat od nich nějakou pastvu pro oči, ale jednou věcí si buďme jisti: dokud má vařečku v ruce James, najíme se velice chutně.

programme.title: Bizarní jídla: Lahodné destinace
programme.desc: 4. série, Tchaj-pej | Andrew zkoumá kulinářské klasiky Tchaj-peje v Tchajwanu, kde jsou knedlíčky velmi nebezpečné a kde je stejně důležité, kdo se s vámi o jídlo podělí, jako jídlo samotné.

programme.title: Bizarní jídla: Lahodné destinace

programme.title: Hyde Park Civilizace
programme.desc: Selfíčka, lajky, filtrované fotky, dokonalé životy, rychlá zábavná videa. Tak na první pohled vypadají sociální sítě. Digitální svět, ve kterém dnešní dospívající tráví velkou část svého volného času. A svět, na němž si mohou vytvořit závislost. Jak nepodlehnout vleku manipulativního designu? Jak doma a ve škole nastavit pravidla používání telefonu? A proč zavádět hranice už od předškolních dětí? Hosty Daniela Stacha budou docentka Kateřina Lukavská a Michaela Slussareff, které se zabývají vlivy digitálních médií na děti a dospívající.
